title: Release check, DPC 0.9.177 + Camera Distance 2.9.20: targeting, co-op cards, items, D-pad orders, loot, ending co-op
intro: About 15 minutes. Single player first (a pawn fight), then co-op with player 1 on keyboard and mouse and player 2 on a controller. Settings switched here last only for this session; your saved ones are untouched.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.mode: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.players: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local n = 0; if D and (D.coop.active or (D.R.cp and D.R.cp.on)) then n = 2 end; for _ in pairs(D and D.R.np and D.R.np.slots or {}) do n = n + 1 end; return n
probes.played: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and tostring(D.state.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.lop: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.lop_n or 0
probes.items: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.item_n or 0) or 0
probes.loots: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.int_n or 0) or 0
probes.dord_n: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.dord_n or 0
probes.dord_played: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.dord_played or 0
probes.dord_last: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local r = D and D.R.dord_last; return r and (tostring(r.name) .. ' order=' .. tostring(r.order) .. ' gesture=' .. tostring(r.ges)) or ''
probes.card_err: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local e = tostring(D and D.R.cards_err or ''); for _, v in pairs({ D.R.c2view, D.R.c1view, D.R.ar2_view }) do if v and v.hud_err then e = e .. tostring(v.hud_err) end end; return e
probes.hid: local m = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.UserInputManager'); return m and m:call('get_HIDInputMode') or -1
probes.fix: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; return (D.cfg.pawn_input_order and 'order ' or '') .. (D.cfg.pawn_prev_state == false and 'prev-off' or 'prev-on') .. (D.cfg.pawn_lockon_from_pawn and ' lockon-pawn' or '')

steps.text: RELEASE CHECK 0.9.177. Part 1, single player. Start as the Arisen, co-op off, full party, out of combat, on open ground. Press End.
1/10 Take control of a melee pawn (F6, or hold D-pad up). Press End when you're playing them.

2/10 Three goblins that can't die appear in front of you. Fight about 30 s: normal attacks, a dash skill (Blink Strike or similar), and switch goblins. Your attacks should go to the goblin you face. Press End to spawn them.
Fight: attacks go to the goblin you face
Was the targeting right? (Remember it.) Press End.
Part 2, co-op. Player 1 on keyboard and mouse, player 2 on a controller. Player 2: hold L3 + R3 to join. Press End once player 2 is in.
Checking that player 2 joined

3/10 THE CARDS (new defaults): a row at the bottom middle, buttons laid out like a controller, bars in the card and under each character. Player 2: hold L1 (skills appear in the same spots; the card must not change size), press a few buttons (they light up). No double bars under player 2. Press End (20 s).
Cards: hold L1, press buttons
4/10 ITEMS: player 2 taps D-pad DOWN alone (no item: it needs L1, as in the game), then holds L1 and taps DOWN (the stamina item). Press End, then do it (15 s).
Items: Down alone, then L1 + Down

expect.label: player 2 used an item with L1

steps.text: 5/10 ORDERS: player 2 taps the D-pad alone: UP (Go), DOWN (Come), LEFT (Wait), RIGHT (Help), a few seconds apart, standing still. Player 2's character should gesture and the free pawns obey and answer. Press End, then do it (25 s).
Orders: up, down, left, right
6/10 SIGNALS: same again, but now only the gesture (the pawns keep doing what they were doing). Press End, then do it (20 s).
Signals: up, down, left, right

7/10 FIGHT AND LOOT: two ordinary goblins appear. Player 2 kills them, then loots a body (prompt in player 2's colour). A dead bandit, if there is one nearby, should be lootable too. Press End to spawn them.
Player 2: kill and loot
8/10 PLAYER 1's CARD: player 1 now has the same card as player 2. Look at it. Press End (15 s).
Player 1's card
9/10 KEYBOARD PROMPTS: player 1 walks to something to pick up or open; player 2 presses buttons. Player 1's prompt should stay a keyboard key. Press End, then do it (15 s).
Player 1's prompts stay keyboard

expect.label: the game stayed in keyboard / mouse mode

steps.text: 10/10 ENDING CO-OP: player 1 takes control of a pawn (F6), then ends co-op with Ctrl + F6. Player 1 should stay on that pawn. Press End, then do it (20 s).
End co-op: player 1 keeps the pawn
Done. Tell Claude: was targeting right, and are the card defaults and the D-pad default (orders + gesture) what you want?
